messages:
sara chen: Quick check — RFC follow-up on kernel rollout controls. I pushed the initial rollout config to staging. Thoughts?

miguel ramos: saw it. Can we confirm per-model override works for quantized kernels?

sara chen: yes, config supports per_model_allowlist. Example:
```yaml
rollouts:
  kernel_rollout_v2:
    default: float16
    per_model_allowlist:
      llama-2-13b: qint8_kv
      long-context-model: float32
    fallback_policy: [model_override, region_override, default]
```

anita patel: do we have metrics gated? want auto-fallback to float16 if qint8 latency regresses 😬

ops-bot: staging-deploy: rev d3f2 deployed — 5/5 pods healthy :white_check_mark:

kai ng: question: fallback policy ordering — default -> model-override -> region-override -> emergency-flag. is that intended?

sara chen: yes. decided priority = model > region > default. emergency flag overrides everything (manual). i'll add to the doc.

miguel ramos: also add telemetry tag `kernel_rollout_v2` so we can filter in dashboards.

anita patel: on regression detection: thresholds? 5% latency p95 increase or 1% error-rate bump? we need exact numbers to avoid flip-flopping.

sara chen: proposed: p95 +4% AND error-rate +0.5% OR quality drop >1.0 (eval harness). if triggered -> automatic rollback to fallback kernel and open incident channel.

kai ng: canary sizing: start at 1% of traffic for 4h, then 10% for 12h, then 50% then 100%. agree?

miguel ramos: make canary window configurable per model; heavy seq-length models need longer sampling.

deploy-bot: rollout plan applied by @sara chen — canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollout ID: r-20240318-42

anita patel: i'll add a checklist for post-RFC tracking items: docs updated, dashboards, alert rules, runbook, owner assigned.

sara chen: :thumbsup: assigning ownership to miguel for first two weeks. i'll update the RFC tracking doc and agents.md pointers.

miguel ramos: got it. i'll sync with telemetry and alerting tomorrow morning.
